snippet.title: EXPEDITION TO THE BACKROOMS DEMO gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to EXPEDITION TO THE BACKROOMS, an immersive survival horror game that takes you deep into the unnerving and infinite maze known as the Backrooms. Inspired by the popular internet myth, this game challenges you to navigate through a labyrinth of monotonous, yellow-tinted hallways filled with the eerie hum of fluorescent lights, unsettling sounds, and the constant fear of lurking entities. You are the exploration team from company Async, you arrive to reported anomaly place and searching for anomalies, but what would you find?
